sb.story.1.text: Today is the Great Sky Balloon Race over Monster Island!

sb.story.2.text: But oh no! Bobbo's balloon is too heavy. It won't lift off!

sb.story.3.text: Whoosh! Puff floats in with a bunch of magic number balloons.

sb.story.4.text: Hi, I'm Puff! Solve each sum, and the balloons will lift Bobbo up!

sb.mid.1.text: Look! Bobbo's balloon is rising higher and higher!

sb.mid.2.text: Bobbo just floated past Zuzu! Keep adding!

sb.mid.3.text: Now he's passing Gloop! The rainbow finish is almost here!

sb.story.end1.text: Up, up and away! Bobbo zooms through the rainbow finish line!

sb.story.end2.text: Bobbo wins the Great Sky Balloon Race! Your careful adding lifted him.

sb.story.end3.text: You found a Brain Spark! Next race, the sums get a little bigger.

sb.help.explain.text: Here's a trick! Start with the bigger number, then count up the rest.

sb.help.hint.text: Let's count on. Hold the bigger number in your head, then count up!

sb.hint.countOn.text: Start at the bigger number, and count on the rest.

sb.hint.model.text: Watch Puff count on. Start big, then count up!

sb.retry.text: So close! Let's try another balloon.

sb.idle.text: Which balloon shows the answer? Drag it to Bobbo, or tap it!

sb.hint.modelTap.text: It makes {n}! Bring the glowing balloon to Bobbo.

sb.praise.1.text: {n}! You counted on from the bigger number!

sb.praise.3.text: You started big and counted up. Great adding!

sb.praise.4.text: That's it! You put the two numbers together.
